paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah ben Yair, a Tanna, Yevamot 86b; Rabbi Yehoshua ben Yair, Taanit, chapter 3, halakhah 4.
The well-known Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair.[^1]

notes.text: Deuteronomy 3:14 explicitly names the biblical Yair ben Menasheh. Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:4 gives Rabbi Yehoshua ben Yair reporting Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair. The consulted Yevamot 86b page did not establish the intended Yehudah ben Yair occurrence; that pointer remains Hyman's report, not a claim of absence from the work. The biblical figure and the separate rabbinic patronymics are not joined.
